builder.description: Arrange modules and lectures, add problems, and control what students can see.
builder.unavailable_body: It belongs to another academy, or your membership cannot open it.
builder.load_failed_body: This is not a permissions problem. Something went wrong on the server — try again, and check the server logs if it persists.
builder.structural_error: Could not save that change. Try again.

empty.heading: Start with a module
empty.body: A module is a chunk of the course — “Loops”, “Functions”. Lectures live inside it, and exercises live inside lectures.

exercise.conflict: Changed in another session — reload before saving
exercise.save_failed_detail: The problem could not be saved. Check the required fields and try again.
exercise.unsaved_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave without saving?
exercise.basic_help: The same fields as the original manual problem form, presented together without hidden sections.
exercise.code_help: Optional code students see when they first open the problem.

field.title: Problem title
field.ai_feedback_hint: This stores the preference. Feedback-rule management is a later migration step.
field.is_visible_hint: Turn this off to hide only this problem. Its content remains editable.

placeholder.title: e.g. Sum two numbers
placeholder.description: Explain the task, examples, and important details.
placeholder.input_format: e.g. The first line contains an integer N.
placeholder.output_format: e.g. Print the sum on a single line.

test.help: Choose per answer whether students see it as a sample or it stays hidden for grading. At least one sample is required.
test.label: Answer {{number}}
test.last_sample_locked: The last sample answer cannot be hidden or removed.

hint.empty: Hints are optional. Add one when a learner may need a gentle nudge.
hint.help: Hints are optional and appear in the order shown here.
hint.label: Hint {{number}}

exercise.preview_student_note: This is what students see. Only sample answers and hints appear here.
exercise.preview_hidden_count_one: {{count}} hidden grading case is not shown to students.
exercise.preview_hidden_count_other: {{count}} hidden grading cases are not shown to students.

error.title: Enter a problem title.
error.test: Add at least one sample answer students can see.

row.hidden_by_parent_tooltip: Set to visible, but hidden because a parent is hidden

visibility_confirm.title: Hide this {{kind}}?
visibility_confirm.description: Review what students will lose access to before hiding it.
visibility_confirm.student_impact: Students will no longer see or open this content.
visibility_confirm.preserved: Visibility choices inside it stay saved. Showing this item again restores the previous visibility of its content.
